paite: "Israel suante kiang ah, 'Kihumbitna khuate bawl in, Mosi zang a na kiang ua ka gen khitsa ahi.
Kuapeuh thei lou leh tumloupi a mi that kha, huai ah atailut thei ding hi. Huchi in sisan phulami a pan nou a ding in kihumbitna ahi ding.

Huai khopite lak a akoi hiam pen a, atailut chiang in, khopi kulhbaang kongpi lutna ah ava dingh ding a, huai kho upate bil a zak in atanchin ava tun ding. Amau khopi sung ah akiang uah apilut ding ua, alak ua aten sam theihna ding in a-omna ding asehsak ding uhi.
Sisan phulami in ahon delhleh athatmi pen akhut ah na pe ding uh ahi kei. A-invengte thei lou a, athah ahi; ama in aho ngal kei hi.

Omkhawmte ma a vai hawmsak dia adin ma leh siampu lianpen a pangpa asih mateng, huai khopi ah ateng ding hi. Huai nung in mithat mi pen amah khosung mahmah, ataikhiaksan khua, amah mah insung ah alut nawn ding ahi,' chi in gen in," achi hi.
Huchi in Naphtali tanggam a Galili a Kadesh, Ephraim tanggam a Shekem leh Judia singtang gam a Kirath Arba, (huai tuh Hebron ahi) asep uhi.
Suahlam ah Jordan gal a Jeriko ah Reuben nam gam a gamdai phaizang a Bezer, Gad nam gam a Gilead gam a Ramoth, Manasseh nam gam a Bashan a Golan asepta uhi.

Hiai khuate ahi Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng leh alak ua namdang tengte a dia seh a om. Kuapeuh mi that kha, hiai khuate a tailut in mipi mai a adin mateng sisan phulami khut ah si lou in a-om thei ding hi.
